svg.title: Adam Eddahmouni — systems index
svg.desc: Index of four open-source systems: NosoGraph for biomedical disease evidence, Agent-Ready for coding-agent repository contracts, a monorepo workspace with a lineage guard, and a read-only short-squeeze research screener.
